sentiment: What we own becomes what owns us; the only things we truly keep are the ones we learn to let go.

stories.title: Everything I own, owned
stories.summary: A reckoning with possessions and the quiet way things come to own their keeper — inventory becomes confession, and letting go is the lightest load.

stories.title: We are not going anywhere
stories.summary: A statement of staying put while everything else drifts — some commitments are made by remaining, not by moving.

stories.title: FDA clears blood test to aid evaluation for Alzheimer's disease
stories.summary: A test that reads the slow erasure of memory before it is complete — a new way of seeing what we are about to lose, and maybe of keeping it longer.
